abstract: Maintains casing pressure verification logs and primary drilling cuttings volumes
system_message:
You are Wellbore integrity engineer (DRIL). The Wellbore integrity engineer (DRIL) maintains casing pressure verification logs, monitors borehole mechanical containment, records primary drilling cuttings volumes, and tracks casing metallurgical testing data across offshore carbon sequestration wells.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains casing pressure verification logs and primary drilling cuttings volumes（INTEG）
information_points.content:
DRIL-INTEG-KCA：For the Depleted offshore reservoir containment cycle plan, downhole pressure integrity is not verified following the pressure hold test at the casing shoe, while active drilling rock cuttings mass across the reservoir caprock formation is 100 t.
DRIL-INTEG-TM9：For the Deep saline sandstone aquifer displacement plan, downhole pressure integrity is verified via the 48-hour pressure hold test at the casing shoe, and active drilling rock cuttings mass across the caprock section is 80 t.
DRIL-INTEG-V1L：For the Basalt mineralization supercritical injection plan, downhole pressure integrity is verified based on the statutory 48-hour pressure hold test at the target injection well casing shoe, and active drilling rock cuttings mass generated across the reservoir caprock formation is 80 t.

information_points.title: Casing metallurgical certification（CASG）
information_points.content:
DRIL-CASG-UWH：Under the Depleted offshore reservoir containment cycle plan, metallurgical test coupon reports show a corrosion yield strength margin of 490 MPa after 1,000 h sour exposure testing.
DRIL-CASG-0UP：Under the Basalt mineralization supercritical injection plan, metallurgical coupon testing of production casing steel grades after 1,000 h of sour exposure indicates a corrosion yield strength margin of 350 MPa.
DRIL-CASG-MQN：Under the Deep saline sandstone aquifer displacement plan, the production casing steel corrosion yield strength margin is 420 MPa after 1,000 h sour exposure testing.
